result.title: GarmentSegAgent: Autonomous Garment Segmentation for Web Fashion Images via Textual Self-Refinement
result.summary: Web fashion images support applications such as visual product search and consumer-to-shop matching, yet their visual heterogeneity makes reliable garment segmentation challenging. Despite advances in promptable segmentation, autonomously identifying and correcting garment-specific errors without human-provided spatial prompts remains difficult. We propose GarmentSegAgent, an autonomous framework that integrates semantic planning, spatial execution, and visual evaluation through iterative textual self-refinement. At its core, we introduce CAST (Constrained Attribution-guided Selective TextGrad), which connects visual error attribution with targeted textual optimization. CAST identifies instruction components responsible for segmentation errors, selectively updates them through textual gradients, and validates the resulting instructions against garment-specific constraints. This enables image-specific error correction at inference time while keeping the underlying foundation models frozen. Experiments on DeepFashion2, ModaNet, and Fashionpedia demonstrate consistent improvements in region overlap and boundary accuracy, alongside more reliable refinement than conventional TextGrad. By enabling visual feedback to guide controlled instruction updates, GarmentSegAgent offers a promising direction for autonomous garment understanding, with potential applications in scalable fashion content analysis, visual retrieval, and consumer-to-shop matching on the Web.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GarmentSegAgent：用语义规划、空间执行与视觉评估构成迭代式文本自 refinement 框架，核心 CAST 依据视觉误差归因定位指令中致错部分，只对相关指令做文本梯度更新，并在服装约束下校验，基础模型保持冻结。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「视觉误差归因→选择性更新可编辑状态→校验是否继续」的推理期闭环，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、贡献分配与停止决策相关，可供核查该归因机制是否比整体文本反馈更有效。
